messages:
Ellie (partnerships): Kicking off a quick sync: we need a dry run for marketplace go-live covering HW badge, SI install flow, landing hero, and press timing. Proposed slot: Fri 10:00 PT. Can we lock?
Raj (marketing): I can own the hero copy + CTA variants. Need partner one-liner quotes and logo files. Prefer svg + 2x png.
Marta (legal): Reminder: partners must sign the marketplace asset agreement before logo usage. Shared the template: https://drive.redwood/agreements/marketplace-asset-agreement.md
Samir (eng): Infra note: tenant provisioning + sample billing events are ready on staging. I'll provide short smoke script. Avoid large token runs during the rehearsal.
Ori (solutions): For SI activation, we'll need a step-by-step runbook and two test tenants with pre-loaded sample data. Also want a screenshare window to validate SSO.
Ellie (partnerships): Action: @Samir can you spin 2 preview tenants by Thu EOD? @Raj ping partners for quotes/logos. @Marta confirm signoff timeline.
Samir (eng): Will create tenants and post URLs in thread by Thu AM. Also posting the smoke test link.
Raj (marketing): I'll aim to get logos + quotes by Thu COB. If not, I'll use a generic hero without partner quote as fallback.
Marta (legal): I'll chase signatures. If any partner delays, we'll remove the quote and add partner logos post-launch.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled: Fri 07:30 PT -> 08:00 PT. (reaction :rocket:)
Ellie (partnerships): Proposed run-of-show for Fri 10:00 PT:
- 10:00 - 10:05 intro + success criteria (Ellie)
- 10:05 - 10:25 SI onboarding demo + SSO check (Ori)
- 10:25 - 10:40 Provisioning + smoke (Samir)
- 10:40 - 10:50 Landing hero final check + visual QA (Raj)
- 10:50 - 11:00 Press embargo simulation & takedown (Marta)
Please confirm availability.
Ori (solutions): Confirmed. Will bring runbook v1.
Samir (eng): Confirmed. I'll run smoke script and monitor metrics.
Raj (marketing): Confirmed. I'll have alt hero ready just in case.
Marta (legal): Confirmed. Will simulate an embargo leak and takedown.
Ellie (partnerships): Outstanding items from thread:
- partner quotes + logos -> owner: Raj / due Thu COB
- signatures on asset agreement -> owner: Marta / due Thu COB
- 2 preview tenants -> owner: Samir / due Thu AM
- SI runbook v1 -> owner: Ori / due Thu EOD
I'll send calendar invite and a short checklist doc. Ping me for blockers. :seedling:
